body:
# autoEdit `1.0.11` release notes 

This version is backwards compatible with previous pre-releases from [1.0.3](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.3), [1.0.4](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.4),  [1.0.5](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.5),   [1.0.6](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.6) ,  [1.0.7](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.7),[1.0.8](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.08), [1.0.9](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.9),[1.0.10](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.10) , [1.0.11](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.11) .

- **For first time users** [see these instructions for installing](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/installing.html) 

- For returning users 

   - **For clean uninstall** [use app cleaner](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/uninstalling.html), this will delete transcriptions you might already have in the app. 

  -  **To keep previous transcriptions** and make use of new functionalities for `1.0.10`.This is only possible if you are  running [1.0.3](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.3), [1.0.4](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.4), [1.0.5](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.5) ,  [1.0.6](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.6) or  [1.0.7](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.7) ,  [1.0.8](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.8) ,  [1.0.9](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.9),  [1.0.10](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.10)  you can just follow [regular instructions for installing](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/installing.html) and drag and drop in applications folder to replace the app. This will keep any transcriptions you currently have in there. 

 When you drag and drop in application folder and chose `replace`.

---

## New Features
- added support for Rev transcription service, [see user manual for more details](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/setup-stt-apis.html#rev-transcription-service),  [and on how to get API credentials](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/setup-stt-apis/setup-stt-apis-rev.html) to use within autoEdit

## Bug fixes and improvements 

- IBM had changed their credentials authentication system, so if using IBM Watson for STT, [this patch](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/pull/50) provide a workaround solution while figuring out potentially a more stable solution.

## Known Bugs
- There seems to be known bug that happens apparently at random when creating a new transcription, sometimes, unclear why, the metadata is not saved for to the transcription. [see issue for more details on best guess](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/issues/51). this is still being investigated to figure out root cause.

---

## Keep up to date with upcoming releases 

Sing up to the [mailing list](http://eepurl.com/cMzwSX), follow on [twitter](http://twitter.com/autoEdit2) and [facebook](https://www.facebook.com/autoEdit.io/) to keep up to date with [the latest releases](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/releases). 

If you have been using autoEdit, I am always super interested in hearing about other people's production and post-production workflow, as well as projects they might have used it for, what has worked best and what hasn't. Say hi at pietro@autoEdit.io, and/or [@pietropassarell](http://twitter.com/pietropassarell) / [@autoEdit2](http://twitter.com/autoEdit2)

## Support 

[There is also a number of different way you can support the project](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/support-the-project.html).

[autoEdit.io](www.autoEdit.io) it's free and open source. Free as in free speech as well as in free beer. [Help support the autoEdit project to keep it that way](https://donorbox.org/c9762eef-0e08-468e-90cb-2d00643697f8?recurring=true). Support will go towards fixing bugs, adding features, provide support for users etc...

# autoEdit 1.0.7 release notes 

This version is backwards compatible with previous pre-releases from [1.0.3](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.3), [1.0.4](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.4),  [1.0.5](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.5) or  [1.0.6](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.6) .

- **For first time users** [see these instructions for installing](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/installing.html) 
- For returning users 
   - **For clean uninstall** [use app cleaner](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/uninstalling.html), this will delete transcriptions you might already have in the app. 
  -  **To keep previous transcriptions** and make use of new functionalities for `1.0.7`.This is only possible if you are  running [1.0.3](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.3), [1.0.4](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.4), [1.0.5](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.5) or  [1.0.6](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.6)  you can just follow [regular instructions for installing](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/content/installing.html) and drag and drop in applications folder to replace the app. This will keep any transcriptions you currently have in there. 
 When you drag and drop in application folder and chose `replace`.

## Bug fixes and improvements 
- Various bug fixes.
- Transcriptions and Paper-edit lists are now sorted alphabetically. (also transcriptions list in paper-edit view)
- fixed broken link in new transcription page pointing to [user manual for setting up STT services](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/setup-stt-apis.html)
- Fixed broken link in settings page for [IBM credentials to user manual](https://pietropassarelli.gitbooks.io/autoedit2-user-manual/setup-stt-apis/setup-stt-apis-ibm.html)
- Wrapped words for transcription title in lists in paper-edit show page, eg if you give it a name with no spaces such as : `test_a_name_so_long_that_needs_wrapping_up_`, for instance when using clip name as name of transcription. 
- Video Keyboard shortcuts now work for transcription text editing mode as well. 
- fixed file upload bug 

## New features
- Added a file validation that greys out unsupported files (using [a list of file supported by ffmpeg](https://github.com/pietrop/ffmpeg_formats_list/blob/master/ffmpeg_extentions.js) ) , if there's an audio or video file you are no longer able to open as a results of this, please do get in touch. 

## Developer notes

- As of `1.0.7` autoEdit runs on `electron` and no longer on `nwjs`.

name: autoEdit_v2 - pre-release
body:
- Fix some major bugs
  - issues when deleting transcriptions 
  - issue when exporting timecode text
  - issue when importing transcriptions 
  - issue when using Gentle 

If you are running [1.0.3](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.3) or [1.0.4](https://github.com/OpenNewsLabs/autoEdit_2/tree/1.0.4)  you can just drop in application folder and replace the app. This will keep any transcriptions you currently have in there. 

If you have a prior version is recommended that you follow [these instructions](http://www.autoedit.io/user_manual/uninstalling.html) to uninstall it. Unfortunately with those earlier versions this will also delete any previous transcriptions you might have.

name: autoEdit_v2 - pre-release
body:
- Changed audio preview to meet `ogg` specs as suggested by IBM  limitations.
- solved bug where clicking `j` `k` `l` would slow down playback speed, stop or increase speed on their own. Keyboard shortcuts now work.
- make it faster to, delete/replace word by auto selecting words text (same as doing `cmd`+`a`) on click and tab in text editing mode.

When updating from previous version. 
- if updating from 1.0.3 simply drag this in application folder and replace app. This should retain media from previous version.
- if updating from earlier version, then follow [user manual uninstall instruction](http://www.autoedit.io/user_manual/uninstalling.html) before upgrading. However this will erase the media in previous version.

name: autoEdit_v2 - pre-release
body:
- App now makes use of `/Library/Application Support/autoEdit2` inside user folder to store
  - IBM Watson API Keys
  - webm and wav media files
  - temp media audio files needed when clipping wav to send to IBM
  - changed db to medea, means no longer 50mb db size restriction. 
- changed deployment to support dmg instead of zip

name: autoEdit_v2 - pre-release
body:
- improved export options layout
- added controls for speed control (fast forward, rewind by 5 seconds increments, as well as increase and decrease speed, and volume control)
- added keyboard shortcuts for speed control

name: autoEdit_v2 - pre-release
body:
This is a relatively stable pre-release where a number of bugs where fixed
- Can now upload multiple videos one after the other.
- When creating a new transcription you are now redirected to an up to date transcriptions list view.
- Deleting transcription refreshes transcription list and deletes associated media file, for transcriptions that have been fully processed.
- Improved `srt` export ( with a maximum of 8 words per line)
